previous_goal_turn_classification: progress: source review exposed target-binding ambiguity and ordinary version-space equivalence; no running process remained at continuation
candidate: Transport multiple source-consistent repairs and act only when their target consequences agree.
tested_scope: Necessary target-identifiability condition only. Correct affine family was supplied as an optimistic structural prior; source repair synthesis and cross-task transfer were not implemented.
observations: Two existing calibrated reactor frequencies read through TALK, four crystals measured with five instruments using successful native USE actions. Only public UI data enter fitting. Nine measured channels; no hidden frequency, formula, keyDimension, scorecard, or attribute access.

consensus_screen.interpretation: All exact-fit candidates disagree too much to admit even a common continuous setpoint. This is zero consensus coverage, not zero task success, and not a proof that stronger priors or target experiments cannot resolve uncertainty.
consensus_screen.baseline_identity: With the same candidate family and observations, set-valued repair consequence inference equals ordinary version-space inference; independent numerical implementations agreed.

simple_program_baseline.selection: Among one-sensor affine fits, choose decimal coefficient strings with least total character length that reproduce both calibration readings within 0.005 Hz. Search 1-12 significant-digit representations, equal binding cost per sensor, and enforce the public 0-10000 Hz range.
simple_program_baseline.structure_prior: The correct affine family is supplied; this is not unrestricted scientific discovery or an LLM agent.
simple_program_baseline.validation: Public terminal task flags and activated reactor names verified against the action trace; all actions succeeded. Same collection action sequences as consensus screen; fresh measurements used for fitting.
simple_program_baseline.limitation: Only three development instances, known function family and scripted navigation. A successful ordinary baseline is not evidence of a new learning mechanism or repair-transfer advantage.

implementation_attempt.reason: Exact observation replay assertion found native radiation-meter background readings differed. Upstream Object creates an unseeded local RNG. The completed v1 run recollects measurements and computes its program from fresh public readings; no stale measurements are used.

decision: Do not scale this consensus-only proposal or count it as novel. Keep the executable baseline for future comparisons; a new method must show benefit beyond target-only simple-program search and must learn any structural prior it claims to transfer.
report_note_cn: 修正迁移的必要条件短测已完成：在给定正确仿射函数形式、但未知传感器绑定和系数的条件下，三个原生 Reactor Lab 实例的六个新晶体均无候选共同支持的设定值；排除超出设备范围的候选后仍相差约2698–6164 Hz。相同候选空间下，该共识操作与常规候选模型推断等价。更强的简单基线仅按系数表达长度选择规则，实际完成3/3任务并激活6/6待调反应堆，未使用源任务经验。两项完成的CPU短测分别约7.4/8.4秒，无API或GPU。结果只支持停止推进这版共识方案，不证明一般修正迁移无效；基线给定了正确函数族且采用脚本导航，不能计为新方法或完整LLM代理结果。

expanded_baseline.supplied_measurement_protocol_recovery: 2/2 on the two selected failure cases; not a learned protocol or unified 10/10 result
